instruction: Candid documentary photograph, high-angle medium shot. Inside an indoor judo training hall on a bright red mat, the short-haired man (R2) sits on the left holding a dark smartphone in his hand, with his right arm draped over the shoulder of the wavy-haired man (R1) who sits closely on the right. Both men are dressed in white judo gis. They are looking down intently at the phone screen with relaxed expressions. Bright, natural light illuminates the scene from the side, casting soft shadows on the vibrant red floor.
